description: This file defines a Shopizer API client module for interacting with various backend services such as catalog, cart, orders, shipping, and system health. It includes type definitions, utility functions, and a factory function to create an API client with methods for making HTTP requests to specific endpoints.

methods.name: createShopizerApi
methods.description: Factory function that creates and returns an object with methods to interact with the Shopizer backend services, including system health, catalog, cart, orders, shipping, and checkout.
